title: Adversarial vulnerabilities and mitigations in unsupervised machine learning: a systematic review
title_zh: 无监督机器学习中的对抗脆弱性与缓解措施：系统综述
abstract: Abstract The use of unsupervised models is growing with the desire to use unlabelled data, and ensuring their robustness against adversaries has become increasingly essential. Although there are surveys that cover some attacks and defences on unsupervised models, a comprehensive review on this topic is missing. We systematically analysed 93 published papers from an initial list of 21,195 papers, identified via a systematic search and reduced through systematic filtration. Our study covered six unsupervised model categories: clustering, super-resolution, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, diffusion models, and transformers. We systematically synthesised the eight types of attacks and nine types of defences identified across these models, providing top-level descriptions, comparisons of methods across unsupervised models, and the essential differences of these attacks and defences in supervised versus unsupervised settings. Our results provide a comprehensive review of current research in this area, identify critical gaps, and offer recommendations for future studies to mitigate the security risks associated with unsupervised learning.
abstract_zh: 摘要：随着使用无标签数据的需求增长，无监督模型的应用日益增多，确保其对抗攻击的鲁棒性变得尤为重要。尽管已有部分综述涵盖了无监督模型的攻击与防御，但关于此主题的全面综述仍然缺失。我们系统地分析了从21,195篇论文中筛选出的93篇已发表论文，经过系统检索与筛选后完成。研究涵盖了六类无监督模型：聚类、超分辨率、自编码器、生成对抗网络、扩散模型和变压器。我们系统地综合了在这些模型中发现的八类攻击和九类防御，提供了高级描述、跨模型方法的比较，以及这些攻击与防御在监督与无监督环境中的关键差异。我们的结果为该领域当前研究提供了全面回顾，识别了关键空白，并为未来研究提出了减轻无监督学习相关安全风险的建议。
